description: What is deployed on a NEAR account, read live from RPC: balance, storage, code hash and size, every method the wasm exports, NEP-330 source metadata (version, source repository and commit, build environment), standards declared or inferred from its methods, FT or NFT metadata, and whether it is a known partner contract, a NEAR Catalog token or the subject of a deprecation entry.
name: get_contract_info
